chunks.subject: AP Physics 1
chunks.title: Q3 Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB) — 10 points
chunks.content: AP Physics 1 FRQ 3 is Experimental Design and Analysis (LAB), 10 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The LAB task requires designing a procedure (identify measured quantities and equipment, control variables), deciding how to analyze data (what to plot to linearize a relationship), and reasoning from data/graphs to a conclusion. Q3 topic: a block-and-spring / gravitation experiment. Points reward: a valid, replicable procedure with correct measurements; a correct plan for graphing/linearizing; correct interpretation of slope/intercept; and conclusions consistent with the data. Common failure: a procedure missing a needed measurement or control; plotting quantities that do not linearize the relationship; conclusions not supported by the plotted data.

chunks.subject: AP Physics 1
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3A, 10/10
chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 10/10 — a complete, replicable procedure with correct measurements, a correct linearizing graph plan, correct slope/intercept interpretation, and data-supported conclusions. Full-credit model for the experimental-design task.

chunks.subject: AP Physics 1
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3B, 5/10
chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 5/10 — earned about half the sub-points, typically the procedure and some data handling but not the correct linearization or the fully data-supported reasoning. Illustrates a partially complete experimental design.

chunks.subject: AP Physics 1
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3C, 4/10
chunks.content: Q3 (LAB) scored 4/10 — earned a few sub-points (e.g., part of the procedure and one analysis element), losing the linearization plan and much of the data-based reasoning. Illustrates a response that describes a rough experiment but cannot analyze it rigorously.
